title: Tencent Hy4 now available on AI Gateway
summary_en: Hy4 from Tencent is now available on AI Gateway , at 50% off through December 31, 2026. Hy4 supports reasoning , tool calling , structured outputs , and image input, and has a 1M-token context window for work across a codebase or many documents. Hy4 is the first Hy model with vision. It can pick out fine detail in an image and read complex charts. It also supports computer use in both command-line and graphical interfaces. Compared with Hy4 Preview , it follows instructions more closely and does better with long context, long-running tasks, and deep research. Use tencent/hy4 as the model…
